name: Honor Guard shoulder cord (metallic silver)
size_basis: No cord dimensions in CAPR 39-1. Length 4.1 in = the Class B shirt shoulder seam (~4.1 in on garment-blues-class-b-shirt-male) and 0.3 in longer than the 3.8 in epaulet strap on the Class A coat (seam 5.04 in), so the cord stays inside the coat silhouette (composed against garment-blues-class-a-coat, -female, class-b shirt/blouse in a throwaway preview 2026-10-13; was 4.5 in); thickness 0.40 in from the cord/length ratio of the app's cord images; colours and braid read from images/cords/*.webp
provenance: in-house vector: braid pattern and colours measured from the app's existing cord images

dimensions.orientation: drawn vertically: top = neck end of the shoulder seam, bottom = sleeve (arm) end; the bow (0.25 in) falls toward the body, i.e. down the garment front when the cord lies on the shoulder
dimensions.attach: align cord_start (neck end) with the neck end of the wearer's LEFT shoulder seam and run it down the seam toward the shoulder point; rotate to the seam angle

garment_fit.note: strap axis = line from the neck end to the arm end of the garment's left epaulet strap / shoulder strip (garment user units, 0.01 in; wearer's left shoulder is on the viewer's right). Place: centre the cord on the axis with shoulder_seam_attach_neck_end at the neck end, rotate so the neck->arm anchors follow the axis, shift the chord 0.125 in toward the neck side so the 0.25 in bow is centred on the strap; draw order garment, layers, cord, then the epaulet sleeve/strip over it

class_b_shirt.note: epaulet_left landmark: pointed neck end to the mid of the arm end

class_b_blouse_female.note: epaulet_left landmark: pointed neck end to the mid of the arm end

mounts.uniform: Class A (service dress) and Class B (blue service), cadets only
mounts.rule: worn on the left shoulder, aligned along the shoulder seam, underneath the epaulet if present; one cord at a time; not worn on working uniforms (CAPR 39-1 9.3, 9.4.1)
